svg.title: CFC architecture: Rust host, Svelte UI and the IPC cycle between them
svg.desc: The Svelte UI in the system WebView posts numbered commands through window.ipc. On the main thread of the Rust host an origin gate accepts them, IpcMessage::parse turns them into a Command, and the CommandDispatcher runs them on its ordered, continuation or blocking lane. Commands mutate AppState behind the SharedState lock and start token-guarded background tasks that use the core services. Under the lock send_snapshot builds a windowed UiState; the Correlated proxy stamps it with the last processed command, the coalescing outbox queues it, and the tao event loop delivers it with evaluate_script to window.render, where it is validated with Zod and put into the Svelte store. ConfigStore writes config.json and GeometryStore writes window.json.
svg.text: A Rust host and a Svelte UI in one window: typed commands go in, complete snapshots come back.
snapshot or event for the UI

post() numbers the command and posts the envelope via window.ipc
The origin gate accepts it; IpcMessage::parse reads it into a Command
The dispatcher queues it on its lane; commands start in arrival order
The command locks SharedState, mutates AppState, may start a task
Still under the lock, send_snapshot builds the windowed UiState
Stamped, queued, coalesced; a Wake token goes to the event loop
The loop takes one event: evaluate_script calls window.render
window.render validates it with Zod and replaces appState
